briefing: An emotional distress audio clip is spreading rapidly, claiming civilians are trapped or harmed near a contested maritime feature. A translated version is going viral faster than the original. Technical review suggests possible synthetic audio or editing. Humanitarian urgency is real, but the media is not yet authenticated.
debrief_prompts: How did humanitarian urgency affect confidence scoring?
Did the player separate rescue action from public attribution?
What translation or synthetic-media risks changed the decision?
How did humanitarian urgency change the temptation to overclaim?

evidence_cards.description: A 19-second audio clip claims civilians are trapped and asking for help. The original file is unavailable and the clip has been reposted many times.
evidence_cards.title: Viral Distress Audio

evidence_cards.description: A technical reviewer notes abrupt waveform transitions and background noise discontinuities consistent with editing or synthetic generation, but the assessment is preliminary.
evidence_cards.title: Preliminary Audio Integrity Note

evidence_cards.description: A translated caption says civilians are being deliberately harmed. A second translator says the original language is ambiguous and may indicate fear rather than confirmed harm.
evidence_cards.title: Viral Translation Thread

evidence_cards.description: A safe-channel query finds no confirmed rescue request matching the viral clip, but local weather and sea conditions remain hazardous.
evidence_cards.title: Search-and-Rescue Channel Note

evidence_cards.description: A family asks whether the voice belongs to a missing fisherfolk relative. Publishing the name or location could expose them to harassment or retaliation.
evidence_cards.title: Civilian Family Inquiry

facilitator_notes: This scenario tests whether players can act with humanitarian care without validating an unauthenticated distress clip.
The correct posture is not indifference; it is verification plus civilian protection.
Watch whether players release names or specific locations without protection review.
Watch whether players separate humanitarian response from public attribution.
learning_objectives: Respect humanitarian urgency without treating unauthenticated media as verified fact
Identify synthetic media and translation risk before public attribution
Protect civilian names, families, and locations from exposure
Use public language that supports humanitarian verification without overclaiming
Separate rescue posture from public attribution posture

release_options.label: Release humanitarian caution: urgent claims are under review; civilian protection and verification are active.
Release urgent confirmation: civilians are confirmed harmed and deliberate action is confirmed.
Hold all public comment until the original audio is authenticated.
Issue media-integrity warning: audio and translations remain unauthenticated; humanitarian channels are being checked.

title: Scenario 02: The Deepfake Distress Call
